explication: This repository is the Datadog Android and Android TV client SDK. Its user-facing workflow is an Android app integrating SDK features to collect telemetry and send it to Datadog; the README specifically documents logs, RUM, and traces, while the tree shows additional flags, session replay, profiling, and crash-reporting capabilities. Core provides feature registration, shared context, persistence, and upload infrastructure. Feature internals are mostly unsampled, so those branches are shown as capabilities without inferred call chains.
